lead: Quantum technology is advancing rapidly, with initiatives aimed at creating quantum-safe networks and enhancing security protocols, particularly in regions like Africa.

stories.title: Cassava and Graphiant reportedly plan quantum-safe networks for Africa
stories.summary: Cassava Technologies is collaborating with US firm Graphiant to introduce quantum-safe networks in Africa, starting in South Africa in 2027. These networks will utilize post-quantum cryptography, designed to withstand future quantum computing threats. While details are still under wraps, this initiative could significantly enhance cybersecurity in the region.

stories.title: Inside X-VPN’s 200%+ Speed Upgrade: 25 Gbps Servers, AI Routing and Talaria Protocol
stories.summary: X-VPN has announced a major speed upgrade featuring its new Talaria protocol, which improves data transfer speeds by over 200%. The upgrade includes enhanced server capabilities and AI routing technology to optimize connection paths. Notably, Talaria incorporates hybrid post-quantum key exchange mechanisms, reinforcing security alongside performance enhancements.

stories.title: Your AI is smarter. Is your business still working the same way?
stories.summary: As AI capabilities grow, many businesses struggle to adapt their workflows accordingly, leading to missed opportunities for performance improvement. The article emphasizes the need for organizations to rethink their processes rather than simply automating existing workflows. This shift could be crucial for leveraging AI's full potential in the context of quantum advancements.

stories.title: Your AI ROI problem is a culture problem
stories.summary: The article discusses the cultural challenges that hinder the return on investment for AI initiatives, with a focus on the importance of people and processes over technology. It highlights that organizations that invest in cultural change alongside technological advancements, including quantum technologies, are more likely to realize significant benefits.
